subject: general
question: If x²+(1)/(x²)=51, then what is the value of (x²-1)/(x)?
solution:
Given:

x2 + 1/x2 = 51

Formula:

(x - 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 - 2

| x | = x

| -x | = x

Calculation:

According to the formula

(x - 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 - 2

⇒ (x - 1/x)2 = 51 - 2

⇒ (x - 1/x) = √49 

⇒ (x - 1/x) = 7

⇒ (x² - 1)/x = 7

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
